title: Analysing Apple Watch data end to end
text: readAppleHealth() streams file, multi-hundred-MB exports fine. Every <Record> becomes row (type, source, unit, start/end, value); <Workout> elements become ah$workouts.
code: ah <- readAppleHealth("apple_health_export/export.xml", tz = "Asia/Tokyo") ah appleHealthTypes(ah)          # what modalities are present, with counts and spans

title: Analysing Apple Watch data end to end
text: watch already stores HRV HeartRateVariabilitySDNN; heart rate HeartRate. deeper HRV raw beats, use single-lead ECG ().
code: hr  <- appleHealthSeries(ah, "HeartRate")                 # bpm, irregular hrv <- appleHealthSeries(ah, "HeartRateVariabilitySDNN")  # ms (SDNN) summary(hr$value_num) summary(hrv$value_num)  # as a PhysioExperiment (irregular; timestamps in metadata) for the ecosystem pe_hr <- appleHealthExperiment(ah, "HeartRate")

title: Analysing Apple Watch data end to end
text: spo2Metrics() reports mean, nadir, time--90% (T90/CT90) oxygen desaturation index (ODI). Note Apple Watch takes periodic spot readings, continuous trace, ODI/T90 approximate unless feed continuous overnight oximetry.
code: ox <- appleHealthSeries(ah, "OxygenSaturation")           # fraction 0-1 PhysioWearable::spo2Metrics(ox$value_num, time = ox$start)

title: Analysing Apple Watch data end to end
text: watch scores sleep stages ; summarizeAppleSleep() turns per-night clinical metrics (TST, efficiency, WASO, latency, stage minutes). instead raw activity counts (another wearable), score sleep/wake Cole-Kripke algorithm summarise :
code: stages <- appleHealthSeries(ah, "SleepAnalysis")          # AsleepCore/Deep/REM, Awake, InBed PhysioWearable::summarizeAppleSleep(stages) sw <- PhysioWearable::coleKripke(counts)                  # counts = per-minute activity PhysioWearable::summarizeSleep(sw)

title: Analysing Apple Watch data end to end
text: epoch-level free-living metrics (ENMO, intensity gradient, fragmentation, HAR → ICF), export raw accelerometry Core-Motion app use PhysioWearable::readAccelCSV() → summarizeFreeLiving() (Apple Health stores derived activity, raw acceleration).
code: steps  <- appleHealthSeries(ah, "StepCount") energy <- appleHealthSeries(ah, "ActiveEnergyBurned") tapply(steps$value_num, as.Date(steps$start), sum)        # steps per day ah$workouts                                               # per-workout summaries

title: Analysing Apple Watch data end to end
text: Apple Watch ECG recordings export one CSV ; readAppleECG() reads single-lead trace PhysioExperiment feeds PhysioECG:
code: ecg <- readAppleECG("ecg_2023-05-01.csv") samplingRate(ecg)                                         # ~512 Hz # baseline-correct + Pan-Tompkins R-peaks, then HRV/rhythm, via PhysioECG proc <- PhysioECG::ecgProcess(ecg) PhysioECG::ecgAnalyze(proc)                               # time/freq/geometric HRV + rhythm

title: Analysing Apple Watch data end to end
text: Raw accelerometry ECG voltage export.xml — ECG separate CSV (readAppleECG()); raw motion needs Core-Motion capture app. SpO2 periodic spot data → ODI/T90 approximate. Sleep stages come Apple’s -device scoring; coleKripke() raw-count actigraphy, re-scoring Apple’s stages. Timestamps carry export’s timezone offset; set tz local zone.

title: Analysing Fitbit and Google Pixel data
Analysing Fitbit and Google Pixel data
text: Fitbit scores sleep stages (wake/light/deep/rem). summarizeSleepStages() turns per-night clinical metrics — engine used Apple Watch, just Fitbit’s stage labels:
code: PhysioWearable::summarizeSleepStages(   fb$sleep,   asleep_levels = c("light", "deep", "rem"),   wake_levels   = "wake",   stage_cols    = c(light = "light", deep = "deep", rem = "rem"))  fb$sleep_summary          # Fitbit's own per-log efficiency / minutes asleep / time in bed

title: Analysing Fitbit and Google Pixel data
text: epoch-level free-living metrics (ENMO, intensity, fragmentation, HAR → ICF) need raw accelerometry, Fitbit export — derived activity.
code: steps <- fitbitSeries(fb, "steps") tapply(steps$value, as.Date(steps$time), sum)     # steps per day

title: Analysing Fitbit and Google Pixel data
text: Phone-level Google data two paths, reusing analysis:
code: # Google Takeout "Fit": granular heart-rate/step JSON + daily-summary CSVs gf <- readGoogleFit("Takeout/Fit", tz = "Asia/Tokyo") gf$heart_rate gf$daily # Android Health Connect: a per-record-type CSV export hc <- readHealthConnect("health_connect_export", tz = "Asia/Tokyo") PhysioWearable::spo2Metrics(hc$spo2$value, time = hc$spo2$time) PhysioWearable::summarizeSleepStages(   hc$sleep, asleep_levels = c("light", "deep", "rem"), wake_levels = "awake",   stage_cols = c(deep = "deep", rem = "rem"))

title: Analysing Fitbit and Google Pixel data
text: Covers Fitbit account archive / Google Takeout JSON layout; exact filenames vary slightly export version (reader keys filename patterns skips parse). Fitbit Web API (OAuth2, live JSON) separate path covered . Google Pixel Watch = Fitbit data (readFitbit()). Google Fit (readGoogleFit(), Takeout) retired Google favour Health Connect (readHealthConnect(), per-type CSV export). Health Connect single official export file, column names vary exporter; reader detects heuristically. raw acceleration continuous SpO2 (spot readings) — limits Apple Watch workflow.

title: PhysioDevices 0.5.0
text: Google Fit Android Health Connect ingestion. readGoogleFit() parses Google Takeout “Fit” export: granular per-type JSON “Data” (heart rate, steps; decoding nanosecond timestamps) “Daily activity metrics” summary CSVs. readHealthConnect() parses Android Health Connect per-record-type CSV export (HeartRate, Steps, OxygenSaturation, RespiratoryRate, SleepSession stages), detecting time/value columns heuristically since exporter layouts vary. spo2 feeds PhysioWearable::spo2Metrics() sleep feeds PhysioWearable::summarizeSleepStages(). fitbit vignette now also shows Google Fit / Health Connect paths.

title: PhysioDevices 0.4.0
text: Fitbit / Google Pixel ingestion. readFitbit() parses Fitbit account archive Google Takeout directory (per-day JSON, plus SpO2 CSV) tidy per-modality series – heart rate, steps, SpO2, resting heart rate – sleep-stage intervals plus Fitbit’s per-log sleep summary. Files discovered name unreadable ones skipped warning. Google Pixel Watch health data stored Fitbit, reader covers . fitbitSeries() extracts one modality. sleep stages feed PhysioWearable::summarizeSleepStages() spo2 feeds PhysioWearable::spo2Metrics(). New vignette fitbit. Requires jsonlite package.

title: PhysioDevices 0.3.0
text: Apple Watch / Apple Health ingestion. readAppleHealth() streams Apple Health export.xml tidy apple_health object: every <Record> (heart rate, HeartRateVariabilitySDNN, OxygenSaturation, respiratory rate, step count, energy, resting/walking heart rate, VO2 max, SleepAnalysis sleep stages) becomes row, <Workout> elements workout table. Apple type prefixes stripped timestamps parsed; large exports handled without loading whole file. appleHealthTypes(), appleHealthSeries() appleHealthExperiment() summarise available modalities, pull one modality’s samples, build (irregular) PhysioExperiment numeric modality. readAppleECG() reads Apple Watch single-lead ECG CSV export PhysioExperiment (voltage, sample rate classification header), ready PhysioECG beat-detection / HRV functions. New vignette apple-watch walks export HR/HRV, SpO2, sleep, activity ECG end end.
